## `reading_admin_note_builder` Skill Framework

### Purpose
Produces dual-version (private/shareable) reading administration notes using a 5-section template structure for library obligations, book club updates, bookmarks/catalogs, personal reading queue, and action items.

### Template Structure (5 Sections)

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                 READING ADMIN NOTES — [DATE]                    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

═ LIBRARY OBLIGATIONS ════════════════════════════════════════════
[Library name, book title, author, due date, status]

═ BOOK CLUB UPDATES ══════════════════════════════════════════════
[Book title, author, host, meeting date, source]

═ BOOKMARKS & CATALOGS ═══════════════════════════════════════════
[Bookmark name, URL/collection reference]

═ PERSONAL READING QUEUE ═════════════════════════════════════════
[Books on deck, priority level, intended action]

═ ACTION ITEMS ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
[□ Checklist items with timeline indicators]
```

### Privacy Filtering Rules

| Redact (Private Only) | Preserve (Both Versions) |
|-----------------------|-------------------------|
| Barcodes, account numbers, PINs | Book titles, authors, general due timeframe |
| Exact message quotes | Specific sender names: "Lisa Anderson", "Rachel Green" |
| Specific URLs | Host names, meeting dates |
| Full contact details (phone/email) | Library names, reading status |
